limitations: Single-user alpha: original ArtCraft UI previews can be registered separately; original UI/server processing and provider parity are pending.
RapidRAW is not bundled: its independent Linux installation remains a separate CLI workflow.

FilmCraft and the bounded DesignCraft PAR-03 sample bridge are separate Actions-built browser preview archives. DesignCraft routes only file.newSample to its owned server worker; other original actions/read-model and all provider/save parity remain pending. These are not complete server-backed original-app bundles.
The native laptop mount helper is not bundled. Use upload or copy-first mode; on-demand/hybrid mounts require a separately installed and verified helper.
CI smoke tests use generated documents; real browser folder permissions and broad format compatibility require separate acceptance.
Linux requires glibc 2.35+; Windows requires the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 x64 runtime; macOS bundle targets Apple Silicon on macOS 14+.
This release stays draft until original-UI asset packaging and target/browser acceptance evidence are complete; it is not a complete creative suite.
